title: In Development - Football League Website
description: Work in progress project for a redesign of a football league website.
Original website is built in wordpress and I wanted to give it a modern look and feel using Next.js and Tailwind CSS.
The new website currently features upgraded design and functionality as well as new features such as a league table, team pages, a news section and a store.
All features are work in progress and may be changed or removed in the future.
